text:
alex: Quick heads-up — proposing a pin of runtime v3.4.1 for hosted inference tomorrow morning. Want to compress the usual 1h window to a 30m window (02:15-02:45 UTC) because EU infra has a maintenance slot at 03:00 and we need a clean cross-region handoff. Ops sign-off please.

jasper (deploy-bot): deploybot queued: pin runtime:v3.4.1 -> pinlist (staged). Target window pending manual confirm. Link: https://deploys.internal/release/7423459999 :robot_face:

mira: :eyes: what's the reason for a hard pin vs soft-unpin? last month's unpin triggered longseq tail regressions.

alex: We observed ~10% tail latency spike for longseqs during staggered unpin last week. This pin is temporary while eng-runtime lands a small KV-cache stabilization patch. Intent is to lift once health signals are stable.

lei: FYI SDK 2.8.0 emits a new header (x-rdinfer-features) runtime 3.4.1 will start using for routing micro-opts. Clients on 2.7.x will still work but may hit routing mismatches and slightly higher latency. Recommend adding an SDK compatibility note and a short grace period.

sam: ops + oncall: if we shorten the window we need a tight rollback runbook. Proposal: 1) if 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p50 latency >25% vs baseline -> immediate rollback to 3.3.9; 2) if p99 > 2x baseline for 10m escalate to eng-runtime. OK?

taylor: agree. Also request a eu-west canary at 10% traffic for 15m before global pin. If canary is green, proceed.

alex: plan adjusted: canary eu-west @02:15 for 15m at 10% traffic. Global apply @02:35 if canary green. Pin window remains 02:15-02:45.

jasper (deploy-bot): deploybot: canary created -> eu-west (10% traffic) for runtime:v3.4.1 at 02:15 UTC. Will auto-report health to channel.

mira: perf telemetry showed a small memory bump on 3.4.1 in canary runs yesterday, but it plateaued after ~8 minutes. Recommend raising memory alert thresholds slightly for the canary to avoid noisy alarms.

lei: I'll write the SDK blurb and ping mobile/web teams. Draft: "SDK >=2.8 recommended for runtime v3.4.1 due to routing header; SDK 2.7.x remains functional but may see higher latency in certain routes."

sam: ops checklist: 1) preflight smoke at 02:10 (health endpoints), 2) router config snapshot, 3) bump eviction thresholds +5% for canary. I'll update runbook.

alex: owners: mira -> health gating config, sam -> runbook & thresholds, lei -> SDK comms. I'll own rollout decision and rollback.

jasper (deploy-bot): deploybot: pin request acknowledged. React with :thumbsup: to confirm owners and start preflight.

mira: :thumbsup: configuring gating now.

lei: :thumbsup: drafting SDK note, will post PR in docs within 10m.

sam: :thumbsup: runbook updated and linked in ops playbook. Will trigger preflight msg at 02:05 UTC.

taylor: adding a longseq tail latency query to the canary dashboard.

alex: I'll monitor the canary and post status at 02:35. If green, I'll initiate global pin.

mira: question: if memory bump reappears within first 5m of canary, do we auto-abort or manual?

sam: auto-abort threshold: worker memory > +12% sustained for 5m -> abort canary and rollback. Also trigger heap dump collection on abort.

alex: agreed. Good call.

jasper (deploy-bot): deploybot: preflight scheduled 02:05 UTC. Will post preflight result and then canary start. Good luck :rocket:
